name: What kind of design aspects or materials might be subject to value engineering?

mainEntity.name: What kind of design aspects or materials might be subject to value engineering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost any aspect of a high-value renovation project can be considered for value engineering, from structural components in a home addition to specific finishes in a custom kitchen. This includes exploring alternative countertop materials, optimizing framing designs, or assessing different types of lighting fixtures that achieve a similar aesthetic and performance. AKN Design Group focuses on maintaining the project's overall design intent and quality standards while seeking smarter solutions that enhance functionality and manage costs effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design aspects like structural components, countertop materials, framing designs, and lighting fixtures can be subject to value engineering to enhance functionality and manage costs.
